question: Alluri Sitaram Raju was a tribal freedom fighter from state ______ of India.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Andhra Pradesh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alluri Sitaram Raju was born on July 4, 1897, in Pandrangi, Andhra Pradesh. **
 
• He led the **Rampa Rebellion**, a tribal uprising against British colonial rule in the **Visakhapatnam district of Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• Raju was influenced by the teachings of **Mahatma Gandhi and his non-violent methods** but eventually resorted to armed rebellion against the British.
 
• He was captured by the British in 1924 and was hanged to death on May 7, 1924.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maharashtra**

 
 
• Maharashtra is a state in western India.
 
• It was formed on May 1, 1960, after the division of the Bombay State into Maharashtra and Gujarat.
 
• Maharashtra has a rich history of freedom fighters who fought against British colonial rule, including Bal Gangadhar Tilak, and Veer Savarkar.
 
 
 
• **Gujarat**
 
 
• Gujarat is a state in western India.
 
• It was formed on May 1, 1960, after the division of the Bombay State into Maharashtra and Gujarat.
 
• Gujarat has a rich history of freedom fighters who fought against British colonial rule, including Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, Mahatma Gandh.
 
 
 
• **Bihar**
 
 
• Bihar is a state in eastern India.
 
• It was formed on March 22, 1912, after the division of the state of Bihar into Bihar and Jharkhand.
 
• Bihar has a rich history of freedom fighters who fought against British colonial rule, including Dr. Rajendra Prasad, Anugrah Narayan Sinha, and Jayaprakash Narayan.
